answer: A strong defence is a refundable stake tied to one verifiable work history: each agent must lock a deposit before it can trade, and that deposit is slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicates. Like a sparrow that can guard only one nest, one stake cannot cover many fake identities at once. A pearl of earned reputation builds slowly through completed jobs, while a reef of peers can challenge suspicious newcomers, so creating thousands of Sybils becomes expensive, slow, and easy to expose.
